english: May this commixture of the Body and Blood of our Lord Jesus Christ be unto life eternal for us who receive it.
notes: n. 129. The target is the Pustet 1862 printed p. 262 formula without 'et consecratio' and 'Amen' (abridged; nothing added).

english: Lord Jesus Christ, let not the partaking of your Body and Blood turn to my judgment and condemnation; but by your goodness let it profit me for the safeguarding of mind and body and for the obtaining of healing.
notes: n. 131, second alternative, ending at percipiendam with no conclusion. The target is the Mainz 1482 fol. 122v prayer without 'quam indignus sumere presumo' and its conclusion, reading 'in iudicium' for 'ad iudicium' (abridged plus one trivial substitution); the English follows the target's 'in'.
